title: fix(objectql,rest)!: serve an object an extension renames without the base's plural (#30391)
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg1JP2CcGNs5hTdBvvidGk1x)_

domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：对象扩展（`.custom` 配对包里的 `object_extension`，或代码包的 `objectExtensions`）只改了 `label`、没写 `pluralLabel` 时，`/meta/object` 不再返回基础包的复数名，也不再返回基础包对旧复数的译文；对象按“没声明复数”的样子返回，列表标题就显示新名字。配对包自己保存了该复数的译文时，返回配对包的译文。
- 为什么改：客户改了对象名，侧栏和列表标题（先读复数）还是旧名字，一个对象两个名字；中文下尤其明显，因为旧复数还被翻成了“任务”。
- 风险与回滚：这是一次已返回值的收窄（BREAKING）：所有只改 label 的扩展都会少返回 pluralLabel，包括 showcase 自带的 `showcase_account`（列表标题从 “Accounts” 变成 “Account (Success Overlay)”）。没有数据迁移，回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `mergeObjectDefinitions`（标量覆盖那一段），再看 `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` 的 `withoutStaleObjectPlural` 和它在 `translateMetaList` / `translateMetaDocument` 里的两处调用。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-object-extension-plural-label.test.ts`，预期 11 条全绿；修复前的代码上有 4 条是红的。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（非受治理面，narrowing 已过达档合同复核 PASS 6658126879）。

Fixes #30391

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — `/meta/object` (item and list reads, both transports) and every registry read of an object (`SchemaRegistry.getObject`, the extension fold) stop serving `pluralLabel` for an object an extension renames without a plural of its own, where they served the base's plural (and, in a translated locale, the base's translation of it). The shipped showcase's `showcase_account` is one. Nothing an author writes is refused, and no exported symbol moves.
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #30466 — `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` "Object Extension Model" says an extension "can add but never remove"; a renaming `label` now takes the base's `pluralLabel` off. The sentence wants that exception (`skills/**` is outside this change's surface).

## What changes

`pluralLabel` is the plural of `label`. The seat's route (served side, under ruling record 6631250894's label order): an extension that changes `label` without `pluralLabel` serves what an object with no `pluralLabel` serves, the pair's own translation first. The new pin measures that reference on the same boot (`crm_note`, which declares no plural): it is served with no `pluralLabel` key in `en` and in `zh-CN`, and the Console then titles a list by the label (`useNavTargetLabel`'s `objectPluralLabel`: served plural, else served label).

Two halves, and each one alone leaves a locale red (Ablations below):

- **The fold** (`mergeObjectDefinitions`, `@objectstack/objectql`). When an extension's `label` is applied (it does not yield to a tenant-authored label, ADR-0029 D9.2a), differs from the running label, and the extension sets no `pluralLabel`, the running `pluralLabel` is deleted. A plural the tenant authored stays (the same D9.2a yield). The fold stays idempotent over an already-folded base: the second pass yields on the label and leaves the plural absent. `getPackagedObjectBase` is untouched and keeps the owner's plural, which the translators compare against.
- **The `/meta` read** (`withoutStaleObjectPlural`, `@objectstack/rest`). The spec's `translateObject` answers a missing `pluralLabel` with the catalog's `objects.NAME.pluralLabel`, and that entry is the base package's translation of the plural the extension left behind (the `en` catalog repeats the source text, so `en` is affected too). Where the served object carries no plural, the packaged base declares one, and the served label diverged from the packaged label, the catalog's plural is replaced by the owner package's `.custom` pair's own translation of `objects.NAME.pluralLabel` (`getPairTranslationBundle(_packageId of the packaged base)`, read once per base per request, translated through `translateMetadataDocument` over the pair's bundle alone), or dropped when the pair has none. Every other object is returned unchanged, and the pair is read only when the rule applies. It runs on both `translateMetaList` and `translateMetaDocument`, which both transports use.

No spec change: the catalog lookup stays the spec's; the server decides what it serves. No ADR text changes: ADR-0146 D10 says an object is extended, never replaced; the base's declaration is untouched and only the served fold changes.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/meta-object-extension-plural-label.test.ts` (new, real `SchemaRegistry` + real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` + `RestServer`, i18n service over a deployment catalog with the pair's row merged in, both reads, `en` and `zh-CN`): the reference (`crm_note`, no plural); a label-only rename serves what the reference serves; the pair's `zh-CN` plural is served and `en` gets none; a pair row translating only `label` does not let the base's plural back; controls: label + plural served as set, plural only, neither (base plural and `任务` kept), repeated label, an untouched object. 4 red on main `09720e2c` (en and zh-CN rename, pair, non-pair), 11/11 after.
- `packages/objectql/src/registry-extension-plural-label.test.ts` (new, the fold): rename drops the plural; packaged base keeps `Tasks` and `_packageId`; idempotent refold; plural set, plural only, fields only, repeated label; tenant-authored plural stays; tenant-authored label makes the rename yield; two extenders in priority order both ways. 11/11.
- Suites at `f71f7bdc` (after merging `origin/main`; the two later commits touch only the changeset and the engine-double ledger): `@objectstack/objectql` 551 files, 10983 passed; `@objectstack/rest` 387 files, 7346 passed / 332 skipped; `typecheck` for both exit 0 (including `check:test-typecheck`); eslint on the four changed source/test files exit 0.

## Ablations

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty.

| | Mutation | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A | the fold's `delete merged.pluralLabel` guarded off (rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` exit 0, then `--absent` exit 0 after the restore rebuild) | objectql 2/11, rest 4/11 |
| B | `withoutStaleObjectPlural` returns the translator's answer unchanged (rest tests import `src`) | rest 4/11 (both locales: the `en` catalog repeats the source plural) |

## Acceptance notes

- **Two names on objects still.** For objects the served `label` reads no pair translation (PR #30353 left objects out of `pairBundle`, seat ruling: an object is extended, never overridden). The plural now reads the pair's translation per this card's route, so a pair that translates both strings gets its plural translated and its label served as written. Carrier: seat (`domain:server#5`).
- **Studio's rename.** A tenant overlay that renames an object and keeps the old `pluralLabel` is untouched (the tenant authored that body, and #8284's pin keeps its plural translated). Carrier: seat, not filed.
- `form-routes.ts` (public form views) translates the form's object schema through `translateMetadataDocument` on its own path, outside this change's surface; for such an object that schema can still carry the catalog's plural. Not measured. Carrier: seat.

## Docs

`content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx`: the merge table's `label` row now says a new label without a plural takes the target's plural off. `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`: the object paragraph of "An edit beats the packaged catalog" now says such an object is served with no plural unless the owning package's `.custom` pair translates it. `releases/**` untouched.
